notes: Placeholder pending the native Mac run. `MODE=generate node scripts/calendar-visual-qa.mjs` captures the 20 developed feature-region candidates, fills generatedDate/generatedFromCommit and SHA-256 checksums, and keeps approvalStatus 'pending'. A Product Jira comment must approve the concrete candidate pack; only then are approvalStatus='approved' and approvalCommentId set. MODE=verify recomputes every SHA-256 and refuses to run on any missing/extra/changed file — approvalStatus text alone is never trusted. A canonical developed-source baseline needs no visual exclusions (masks: []).
